drivingQuestion: Why may a Samaritan be included in a zimmun, when he is at best an am ha'aretz and a baraita rules that an am ha'aretz is not included?
outcomeNote: The objection stands unanswered within this unit; its answer comes in the following unit, which is not in this packet.

segments.he: וְהַכּוּתִי מְזַמְּנִין עָלָיו: אַמַּאי? לֹא יְהֵא אֶלָּא עַם הָאָרֶץ! וְתַנְיָא אֵין מְזַמְּנִין עַל עַם הָאָרֶץ!
segments.en: The mishna states that «a Samaritan [Kuti] may be included in a zimmun.» The Gemara asks: «Why?» Even if you consider him a member of the Jewish people, «let him be merely an am ha’aretz,» one who is not scrupulous in matters of ritual purity and tithes, «and it was taught» in a baraita: «An am ha’aretz may not be included in a zimmun.»
